correctness.rationale: The successor rule computes both neighbor influences from the pre-spread state, then ignites exactly one remaining vertex unless terminal. Burned sets strictly increase, so exhaustive closure gives all and only legal terminal words. An independently written two-mask round search plus a multisource hypercube BFS reproduces all counts, run types, and distance histograms at orders 3–10. It confirms that the 8 nonconstant order-four words are exactly the singleton-minority words, and compares all two-boundary words at orders 5–10. At order ten the two alternating targets alone attain radius four; the independently enumerated path has radius three. For n≥10 fire from any given ignition cannot reach farther than its number of completed spreads: vertices 2, 4 and 6 evade all previous sources when ignited, in particular d(0,6)≥4 at round four. Their permanent alternating signs force a boundary on each of the four disjoint arcs in any completion. Balanced signatures form the positive switching class; switching carries the code by coordinate sign flips, giving the stated n minus radius plurality corollary.
residual_risks: The infinite construction proves at least four boundaries, not an exact code, covering radius, or extremal boundary count for n>10. This is the Finding's quantifier; the shorthand in Limitations should not be read more strongly.
